text: Chapter 5 teaches the foundational application of passing tones and melodic embellishment within 3-part chord voicings (the master's characteristic moves), using C Major scale exercises (no accidentals) as the pedagogical anchor across pages 15-35. The chapter establishes that all material is presented in C Major to maintain clarity, with the explicit expectation that students have already developed sufficient transposition skills to adapt the exercises to other 7-note scales independently. By concentrating on a single key area without chromatic complications, the chapter isolates the techniques of chord construction and melodic decoration, allowing readers to focus on voice-leading patterns and embellishment strategies before applying them across different tonal centers.
